newsitem.title: UK: Trafficmaster climbs on news of German deal.
newsitem.headline: Trafficmaster climbs on news of German deal.

text.p: Shares in British traffic information group Trafficmaster Plc climbed on Wednesday after the group announced a joint deal to provide traffic information services in Germany, UK market makers said.
The stock was up 19p, or 6.91 percent, trading at 296p by 1010 GMT.

"The stock was completely boosted by the announcement of the German deal, especially if you look at the greater amount of kilometres of autobahn (motorway) in Germany compared to the UK," one dealer in the shares said.
Trafficmaster this morning announced a 12-year licensing deal with German engineering and telecommunications group Mannesman AG and Deutsche Telekom AG to provide Trafficmaster services in Germany.

The group said the service planned to cover 4,000 kilometres of autobahn by the end of this year with a further 4,000 planned by mid-1998. It said the German motorway network covered over 10,000 kilometres.
